# GitHub Discussions Configuration & Categories

To foster vibrant, structured open-science discussions, the following categories are recommended for GitHub Discussions:

| Category | Format | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| **Announcements** | Announcement | Milestone releases, journal submissions, preprint updates |
| **General** | Open discussion | High-level CCU debate, industrial deployment news |
| **Catalyst Benchmarks** | Open discussion | Discussing newly published 2025–2026 laboratory benchmarks |
| **Thermodynamics & Reaction Kinetics** | Q&A | In-depth mechanistic questions, NIST value inquiries |
| **LCA & TEA Modeling** | Q&A | Grid carbon intensity assumptions, hydrogen cost modeling |
| **Ideas & Proposals** | Open discussion | Brainstorming new review angles, new pathway proposals |
| **Q&A** | Q&A | Technical help with Python build scripts and CSV schemas |
